title: ECA Costume Show
description:
I performed in the ECA Costume Show 2018 and 2019, as Sister Sage and Pamina.

Click me to see more!

details.value:
I performed in the ECA Costume Show 2018 and 2019. It is always a wonderful, thrilling experience and a great opportunity to make creative connections backstage!

I wore Callum Miller's costume for The Bees character, Sister Sage (on the left). Click [here](https://www.instagram.com/callumillercostume_/) for more of Callum's work.
I wore Lada Sotirova's costume for The Magic Flute character, Pamina (on the right). Click [here](https://www.instagram.com/l.d.sotirova/) for more of Lada's work.
